## File: facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/detectron2/detectron2/data/samplers/distributed_sampler.py

Prompts

```
['create a TrainingSampler to produce an infinite stream of shuffled dataset indices for distributed training', 'create a RandomSubsetTrainingSampler to sample a random subset of indices by a given ratio for training', 'create a RepeatFactorTrainingSampler to sample indices with stochastic repeat factors for class imbalanced datasets', 'compute per-image repeat factors from category frequency using RepeatFactorTrainingSampler.repeat_factors_from_category_frequency', 'create an InferenceSampler to produce shard indices for inference across distributed workers']
```

Usage

```
{'create_training_sampler': 'create a TrainingSampler to produce an infinite stream of shuffled dataset indices for distributed training', 'create_random_subset_training_sampler': 'create a RandomSubsetTrainingSampler to sample a random subset of indices by a given ratio for training', 'create_repeat_factor_training_sampler': 'create a RepeatFactorTrainingSampler to sample indices with stochastic repeat factors for class imbalanced datasets', 'compute_repeat_factors_from_category_frequency': 'compute per-image repeat factors from category frequency using RepeatFactorTrainingSampler.repeat_factors_from_category_frequency', 'create_inference_sampler': 'create an InferenceSampler to produce shard indices for inference across distributed workers'}
```
